description_excerpt: Job Description Get to Know the Team The Vietnam Operations team oversees, shapes and grows the business in Grab Vietnam. We develop business strategies to achieve our vision in providing everyday services that matter most to consumers in Vietnam. GrabMart is a fast-growing vertical within Grab. GrabMart focused on delivering everyday essentials to our customers by our app. As part of the Commercial team Get to Know the Role You will be reporting to the Head, GrabMart & Omnicommerce help shape the strategy, building partnerships, and driving execution to grow Grab's presence and influence…
